scaling_parameter.name: num_threads
scaling_parameter.description: Total number of threads launched (each performs num_atomics_per_thread atomic adds)

block_size.description: Thread block size for kernel launches

num_atomics_per_thread.description: Number of atomicAdd operations each thread performs

num_counters.description: Number of counters in the global array (1=high contention, 32=medium, 1024=low)
